name: Spotlight
summary: Stage spotlight on a tripod stand with a warm light cone; anim on flicks it on, sweep turns the beam across the stage.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the stand foot

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the stand's feet rest on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale; 1 m is about 560 px, so at s = 1 the spotlight is about 1.6 m (900 px) tall

params.name: anim
params.note: on = the light fades up and holds; sweep = the head turns and the beam swings left and right

author: krakujs
